text: この　へんまで　くると　あんまり　むしも　いないんだ

structure.jp: この　へんまで　くると
structure.en: once you come as far as this area

structure.jp: あんまり　むしも　いないんだ
structure.en: there aren't many bugs either, you see

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a verb says that when the first thing happens, the next thing follows. くると = 'once you come'.

patterns.name: あんまり〜ない
patterns.span: あんまり　むしも　いない
patterns.explanation: あんまり together with a 'not' word means 'not very much'. あんまり　むしも　いない = 'there aren't many bugs'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ and gives the sentence an explaining tone, like 'you see'. いないんだ = 'there aren't any, you see'.
